scope: Compact export of recorded measurements; detailed arrays removed, not a new experiment.

protocol.scope:
Frozen contextual-feature ablations with identical training and label budgets.

Exploratory development study. No protected-period loader is provided.
protocol.weighting: Exact same environment-by-class inverse-frequency weights as original strongest baseline.
protocol.interpretation: Port-derived categories are fallible service hints, not verified application identity or labels.
protocol.input_scope: Transport ports and existing exporter fields only. No endpoint identity, raw port feature, clock, history or protected row IDs.
protocol.model_selection: Identical three fits per representation/seed. Original pooled and stricter window constraints reported separately; thresholds calibrated once on separate fixed benign data.
protocol.baseline: Reuse exact three fitted physical14/harmonized14 environment-balanced artifacts; new variants use same rows, weights and fit seeds.
